calculation.description: Compute the cross-sectional percentile ranks of 20-day and 60-day returns, average them, lag the signal by one completed session, and invert for a long-only reversal score. Forward validation uses the next 10 trading-day return.

validation.regime_notes: Inverse orientation passes the absolute benchmark gates on the full sample, but is regime-dependent: 2020-2025 IC +0.03906, ICIR +0.0979 before inversion; 2026-2029 IC -0.04778, ICIR -0.1402 and 2030-2033 IC -0.03482, ICIR -0.0981 for the original momentum orientation. The persisted reversal orientation is intended for the latter regimes; monitor drift and correlation. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
